Wet Bottom

The classic sea battle as a glowing hologram on your table, played with your hands.

Meta Quest ↗Meta Horizon Store

Wet Bottom is the sea battle you played on paper, projected as a hologram into your room.

A tray of glowing contour lines becomes the sea. Your fleet rides the swell; on your turn the projector flickers over to the enemy's waters — another seabed, ships you cannot see until you sink them.

AIM ANY WAY YOU LIKE

  • Turn two ship's wheels and slam the big red button
  • Look at a cell, or drop a pointer arc on it
  • Tap it on a small tablet beside the console
  • Write it in the air with a pinch — "D6"
  • Or hold the radio key and say it: "delta six, fire!" (recognised on the headset)

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

  • Turn by turn: a hit fires again
  • Countdown salvo: ten shots your first turn, nine the next… down to one

PLANES, SUBMARINES, AA GUNS

Earn coins, buy them from the rack at your elbow. Fly a bomber down two columns, send a submarine under the enemy's fleet and aim its torpedo, keep AA guns ready for the raids that come back at you.

CLIMB THE RANKS

From Cabin Boy to Admiral: each rank a sharper gunner.

PLAY A FRIEND ONLINE

Invite a friend from Meta Horizon or share a 4-digit room code, then battle one-on-one. Climb the world and friends Victories leaderboards.

MADE FOR MIXED REALITY

Play over your real room, in darkness or under a dusk sky. Lay the sea flat, tilt it to 45° or stand it up like a wall — the console stays at your hands. Drag the whole field wherever it suits you.

Hand tracking first; Touch controllers work too. A navigator calls the battle in English or Russian.
